_comment: Chromebook Plus (Linux/Crostini). Thin client: no local MCP servers, no GPU, no Supabase service key on disk. Real work is pushed to DGX Spark over SSH.
_hic_decision: 2026-08-13 - HIC authorised shipping permissions.defaultMode=bypassPermissions across all four environments. Rationale: there is a single contributor, and bypassPermissions only skips the permission prompt and the settings.json deny list - it does NOT disable PreToolUse hooks, which fire earlier in the agentic loop and remain the real enforcement layer (see CLAUDE.md 'Secret Egress Rules' and .claude/hooks/pretooluse-guard.sh). If a second contributor joins, revisit this: the deny list becomes load-bearing again.
